---
purpose: Greet a user by name, optionally in a formal register.
inputs:
  - name: name
    description: The person's name.
  - name: formal
    description: When truthy, use a formal greeting.
    required: false
  - name: team
    description: Team name for the shared signature partial.
model_tips: Any small model handles this.
---
{{#if formal}}Good day, {{ name }}.{{else}}Hey {{ name }}!{{/if}} Welcome aboard.
{{> signature }}
